APM Terminals 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 About Us
 At APM Terminals, we are a global leader in port and terminal operations, enabling global trade and creating opportunities for our customers and communities. We are committed to operational excellence, innovation, and building resilient technology foundations that support our business worldwide.
 
 About the Role
 We are seeking a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to join our Infrastructure team in Mobile, Alabama. In this role, you will serve as a senior technical authority responsible for designing, architecting, implementing, and optimizing enterprise-scale infrastructure solutions that support critical terminal operations. You will lead modernization initiatives across compute, virtualization, cloud, storage, and infrastructure platforms while partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to drive reliability, security, and continuous improvement. This is an opportunity to have a direct impact on the technology foundation of a growing global organization.
 
 What We Offer
 Opportunity to lead strategic infrastructure modernization initiatives in a global organization.
 Exposure to enterprise-scale virtualization, cloud, compute, and infrastructure technologies.
 A collaborative environment focused on innovation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
 Relocation support available for qualified candidates.
 
 Key Responsibilities
 Design and architect enterprise-scale infrastructure solutions across virtualization, compute, storage, backup, and cloud environments.
 Lead complex infrastructure projects from planning through implementation, including risk management and stakeholder engagement.
 Provide expert-level troubleshooting and serve as the final escalation point for critical infrastructure incidents.
 Develop and maintain infrastructure standards, technology roadmaps, and modernization strategies.
 Implement automation and Infrastructure-as-Code solutions to improve scalability, efficiency, and consistency.
 Drive security, compliance, disaster recovery, and business continuity initiatives across infrastructure platforms.
 Mentor infrastructure engineers and promote knowledge sharing, technical excellence, and best practices across the team.
 Evaluate emerging technologies and conduct proof-of-concept activities to assess business value and technical feasibility.
 Lead capacity planning and performance optimization initiatives across infrastructure environments.
 Conduct root cause analysis for major incidents and implement preventive measures to improve system reliability.
 
 Who We Are Looking For
 We recognize that experience comes in many forms. If you don't meet every qualification, we still encourage you to apply.
 Demonstrated continuous improvement mindset with a passion for solving problems, optimizing systems, and challenging the status quo.
 Strong experience designing and supporting enterprise virtualization environments, particularly VMware and ideally Nutanix.
 Experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS, and a solid understanding of modern infrastructure architectures.
 Proven ability to lead complex technical projects and influence stakeholders across multiple functions.
 Strong understanding of infrastructure security, resilience, high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity principles.
 Experience developing automation solutions, infrastructure standards, and operational best practices.
 Experience mentoring junior and mid-level engineers and contributing to a culture of technical excellence.
 Fluent English communication skills are required; Spanish is considered a plus.
 Curiosity, analytical thinking, and a proactive approach to researching and resolving technical challenges.
 
 Employment Details
 Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
 Location: Mobile, Alabama, United States (100% On-site)
 Work Schedule: Typically Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM
 On-Call Expectations: Participation in on-call support as needed; critical events are infrequent
 Salary Range: USD $90,000 to $110,000 annual base salary
 
 Work Authorization: Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Sponsorship availability, if applicable, will be discussed during the recruitment process.
 
 Salary Disclaimer: The posted salary range reflects the anticipated base salary for this position. Actual compensation may vary based on skills, experience, qualifications, location, and other business considerations.


 
 Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.
